inputs.request: SELECT q.source_id, q.nss_solution_type, q.period, q.period_error, q.eccentricity, q.parallax, q.parallax_error, q.significance, q.goodness_of_fit, q.flags, q.a0_mas, q.f_m, g.ra, g.dec, g.l, g.b, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ruwe, ap.mass_flame, ap.mass_flame_lower, ap.mass_flame_upper, ap.radius_flame FROM (SELECT q2.source_id, q2.nss_solution_type, q2.period, q2.period_error, q2.eccentricity, q2.parallax, q2.parallax_error, q2.significance, q2.goodness_of_fit, q2.flags, q2.a0_mas, POWER(q2.a0_mas/q2.parallax, 3)/POWER(q2.period/365.25, 2) AS f_m FROM (SELECT q1.source_id, q1.nss_solution_type, q1.period, q1.period_error, q1.eccentricity, q1.parallax, q1.parallax_error, q1.significance, q1.goodness_of_fit, q1.flags, SQRT(0.5*(q1.ta*q1.ta+q1.tb*q1.tb+q1.tf*q1.tf+q1.tg*q1.tg)+SQRT(POWER(0.5*(q1.ta*q1.ta+q1.tb*q1.tb+q1.tf*q1.tf+q1.tg*q1.tg),2)-POWER((q1.ta*q1.tg-q1.tb*q1.tf),2))) AS a0_mas FROM (SELECT source_id, nss_solution_type, period, period_error, eccentricity, parallax, parallax_error, significance, goodness_of_fit, flags, a_thiele_innes AS ta, b_thiele_innes AS tb, f_thiele_innes AS tf, COALESCE(g_thiele_innes, -a_thiele_innes*f_thiele_innes/b_thiele_innes) AS tg FROM gaiadr3.nss_two_body_orbit WHERE nss_solution_type IN ('Orbital', 'AstroSpectroSB1', 'OrbitalTargetedSearch', 'OrbitalTargetedSearchValidated', 'OrbitalAlternative', 'OrbitalAlternativeValidated') AND parallax > 0 AND parallax/parallax_error > 5.0) AS q1) AS q2) AS q JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g ON g.source_id = q.source_id LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS ap ON ap.source_id = q.source_id WHERE q.f_m > 0.25
